decisions.reason: After surviving its first review, the desk lamp appears to meet a tolerable aspiration level and, although it is less central than the firm's integrated lighting systems, a large firm with some slack would usually keep such an ergonomic niche product unless results clearly deteriorate.

This general interior luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core building-lighting business, and continued market presence after launch suggests performance is at least satisfactory relative to aspirations, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.

Because management has framed this pendant luminaire as a flagship aligned with the firm's strategic move toward advanced, efficient lighting, behavioral-theory logic implies strong internal commitment and a very low likelihood of near-term withdrawal.
